items.claim: Wes Schultz has poor wrestling entries, shooting from too far out with sloppy takedowns.
items.quote: he has a wrestling background, but his his wrestling entries are just so bad. He's shooting from so far out. He's shooting in all these sloppy takedowns.

items.claim: Wes Schultz looked terrible in his fights against Damen Penis and Ben Johnston.
items.quote: Wes Schultz looked god awful against Damen Penis. He looked god awful against Ben Johnston until Johnston gassed out.

items.claim: Jax McVey has never won a fight past the first round and fades significantly in the second round.
items.quote: Jax McVey has not won a fight past the first round. We saw in the Zach Reese fight with Jax McVey. Once the fight reached the second round, he really had nothing left.

items.claim: Jax McVey's submission defense is suspect.
items.quote: Jax McVeyy's submission defense is pretty suspect.

items.claim: Jessa Chavez fought very low-level competition in shopping malls and elementary school gymnasiums before the UFC.
items.quote: she's fought the worst competition you'll ever see in your entire life before getting into the UFC and Contender Series... she's fighting in shopping malls. She's fighting in elementary school gymnasiums.

items.claim: Jessa Chavez was losing her fight against Sophia Montenegro until a referee confusion led to her winning and getting a contract.
items.quote: she got hurt in that fight. She was on her way to losing the fight until the ref um warned Montenegro to to start working and and she thought that the ref told her to get up and that's the only reason Chavez won the fight and got a contract.
